label: Illustrative shaders
tagline: Curated stackable-shader art-direction for canvas / ambient / background slots
description: Picks a STACKABLE shader treatment (source -> filter -> unifier) for shader slots (canvas backgrounds, ambient hero fields, declared data-medium=shader, full-bleed generative fills) BEFORE visual-orchestrator's per-medium dispatch. Sibling of photography-orchestrator / illustration-orchestrator, but procedural - NOT gated on an image-gen model (zero API cost). Reads docs/research/shader-library.index.json (32 curated entries in the shaders.figma.com / paper-design register: 16 SOURCES - mesh-gradient / fractal-noise / clouds / nebula / glowing-wave / neuro-noise / godrays / water-caustics / particle-web / magnetic-field / metaball-merge / moire-interference / concentric-patterns / dither-waves; 16 FILTERS - gradient-map / channel-mixer / dither / halftone / hatching / color-outline / lens-distortion / organic-distortion / pattern-refraction / particle-stretch / pixelate / slice-shift / chromatic-metal / bokeh-blur / riso-print / luminance-particles). For each shader slot it picks a stack by consulting the index decisionTree against the committed aesthetic, writes a pe_shader_<slotId> enrichment node (promptForShader for the prototype shader skill, OR fxStack of live fx-engine effect ids for app-node composer surfaces, plus palette / register / motion hints), and visual-orchestrator reads these when dispatching the shader medium. OPTIONAL - fires when (a) a shader-register slot exists AND (b) the committed aesthetic wants a generative/animated register per the decision tree, OR on explicit user request (dither waves / neuro-noise / godrays / riso-print / fluid halftone / 'make it a shader'). Foreground subjects / photos / illustrations route to illustration / photography orchestrators, not here. Cold-isolated per project.

hardRule.header: Illustrative shaders: dispatch shader-orchestrator BEFORE visual-orchestrator
hardRule.body:
The shader sibling of the photography / illustration art-direction rules - same BEFORE-visual-orchestrator timing, the stackable illustrative-shaders library instead, and NO image-gen gate (shaders are procedural).

- **Gate A - shader slots exist.** At least one slot in the scaffolded source resolves to a procedural SHADER treatment: explicit `data-medium="shader"`, a `<canvas>` with a background / ambient / hero-field role, a full-bleed `background-image` better expressed as math than a baked raster, or a declared `shader/*.js` path. Foreground subjects, photos, and illustrations are NOT shader slots (they route to illustration / photography).
- **Gate B - aesthetic wants a generative register.** The committed aesthetic is in the shader library `decisionTree` (cyberpunk, recipe-ai-foundry-dark, cassette-futurism, vaporwave, acid-design / acid-graphics, cosmic-horizon, bioluminescent-deep, op-art, y2k-futurism, frutiger-aero, aurorism, depin-hardware, dark-botanical-maximalism, editorial-magazine for riso, monochrome-pop-poster, ...). Explicit requests naming an effect ("dither waves", "neuro-noise hero", "godrays", "riso-print the page", "fluid halftone", "make it a shader") always count.

When BOTH gates pass (or on explicit request):

```
Task(subagent_type: "shader-orchestrator",
     description: "Pick a stackable shader treatment per shader slot",
     prompt: "<envelope per shader-orchestrator.md §1.1 - projectId, branch, committedAesthetic, surface (prototype|app-node), explicitStylePicks, sensoryTargets, antiPatterns, artContract>")
```

It commits one `pe_shader_<slotId>` enrichment node per shader slot (a source -> filter -> unifier STACK, with `promptForShader` for the prototype `shader` skill, or `fxStack` of live fx-engine effect ids for app-node composer surfaces). visual-orchestrator Step 0a reads those nodes and hands the brief to the `shader` drawer verbatim. Runs alongside photography / illustration (different slots); all three are siblings, not alternatives. If the gates fail, it returns `runStatus: error` and visual-orchestrator proceeds with default media.

- ❌ Hand-write a GLSL background in chat when the gates pass - the library decision tree owns the stack pick, the `shader` skill owns the GLSL.
- ❌ Route a foreground subject / photo / illustration here - those are illustration / photography slots.

triggers.title: Shader art-direction pass (BEFORE visual-orchestrator)

No image-gen gate (procedural). If conditions fail, returns runStatus:error and visual-orchestrator proceeds with default media.
